reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(nums)
    top = [x[0] for x in counts.most_common(k)]
    print(' '.join(map(str, top)))
